2 DUTIES OF THE PRESIDENT PRO TEM The President Pro Tem shall preside over all meetings in the absence of the President of Council. CLERK OF COUNCIL Members of Council shall, within ten days of the commencement of their term, elect a Clerk of Council. DUTIES OF THE CLERK OF COUNCIL A. The Clerk of Council shall attend all meetings, regular and special. When, in the event of the Clerk of Council’s absence (planned or unplanned), the Clerk of Council duties, both during a scheduled meeting and written Council Minutes produced from the Council meeting, will pass on first, to the President of Council, secondly, to the President of Council Pro Tem (in the event of the President of Council’s absence), or thirdly, any elected Ward Council Member or Council-At-Large Council Member, by a majority vote of all members elected to Council.
